claims.citation: New York Herald, 12 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Brig Flying Cloud (of Guernsey), Jarren[?], Messina, 68
days, with fruit, to G F Bulley. May 15, lat 26 50[?] lon 40 41,
spoke bark Carlos & Carlotta, from Rio Janeiro for Havre,
32 days out; 31st, lat 31 49, lon 59 47, schr Maria J Morse,
from Boston for Barbados, 9 days out; June 10, lat 33 37, lon
72 50, bark Argo, bound W.
